_comment: DECISION 2026-10-08: values replaced with parameters/tables/T08_assignment_tiers_US_candidate.csv's real US tier values (HCM 7th ed. / NCHRP 825 planning-level reads) -- previously these were the UK-relabeled values FLOOD_TABLE_REVIEW.md flagged as the central audit finding (arterial 2200 veh/lane-h and 60 mph vs. the real US 900 and 45; collector 1700/55 vs 700/40; local 1000/35 vs 550/30). T08's own flow_breakpoint column is not a usable single number for 3 of 4 tiers ('n/a (use BPR)', and freeway is a range) because T08 assumes a classic BPR a/b power-law congestion curve, which this codebase's actual edge-speed model does not implement -- it uses a piecewise-linear breakpoint+slope model instead (see networks/t08b_profile.py). flow_breakpoint/congestion_factor below are therefore DERIVED from T08's real flow_cap_plph/free_flow_speed via that same piecewise-linear model's own documented formulas (Q_bp = 0.85 x capacity; slope = free_flow_speed / (1.15 x capacity) -- NCHRP 825 Exhibit 128's own linearization, already used identically in resiflow.networks.t08b_profile and verified there against the real exhibit), not read literally off T08's BPR-oriented column. See docs/FLOOD_TABLE_REVIEW.md.
_centroid_connector_comment: DECISION 2026-10-22: centroid_connector is a synthetic 5th tier for inserted subarea-access links (see resiflow.preprocess.network_connector_insertion), distinct from the 4 real road tiers above -- it represents omitted local access the way a conventional travel-demand-model centroid connector does (VA Statewide Model precedent: VDOT's VASWM Citilabs Cube network codes centroid connectors as FACTYPE 11 with capacity 10,000 veh/lane/hr flat across area types (~5-15x a real Interstate lane) and excludes them from the volume-delay/congestion function entirely -- see 01NET00A.S's own comment 'all facility types except for centroid connectors'). free_flow_speed=20.0 mph is VA's 15-25 mph range midpoint, used here as a STARTING precedent only -- not calibrated for any specific ResiFlow network and needs sensitivity testing before being trusted as a real access-time estimate. congestion_factor=0.0 and min_speed_cap=free_flow_speed together give connectors genuinely fixed impedance (speed never changes with flow) via the existing tier-profile mechanism in update_edge_speed, with no change to the core assignment loop. flow_cap_plph=10000 (matching VA's convention) makes capacity practically non-binding without literally excluding connectors from capacity-restrained reassignment.
